subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the retargeting program for {Brand}, after my earlier emails on completed-order optimization and the rising cost of winning an order back. If incremental, validated orders are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the cuisine-segment and holdout read on comparable US aggregators this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN food_and_delivery: references prior email and earlier stages (completed-order optimization + cost-to-win-back angle); direct close with easy out (releases prospect if timing wrong); no figures, no illustrative flags; zero question marks; native register; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
